trends.whatProductOffers: Lets the policyholder pick a zero, HKD16,000 (USD2,000) or HKD25,000 (USD3,125) annual deductible, which changes how much of each claim is self-funded before the plan pays.
exclusionsOrConditions: The premium difference between tiers is not stated in the source.
The deductible applies per policy year as labelled on the product page.
A higher deductible means more out-of-pocket before benefits start - the source does not spell this out, so explain it as product mechanics rather than a quoted feature.
